environment.description: Service runs on EC2 in isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT). Exposed exclusively through AWS PrivateLink (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b2c1d3e5f6a7). VPC endpoint interface provisioned with private DNS disabled. Endpoint policy restricts aws:PrincipalOrgID to o-a1b2c3d4e5. The NLB target group has a per-target connection count limit of 50 concurrent connections and a deregistration delay of 300s. The VPC endpoint service requires manual acceptance of endpoint connection requests. Security group on the ENI (sg-9f8e7d6c5b) allows inbound only from the NLB subnet CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 on port 8080. No public IP, no internet gateway attached to VPC, route table has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). The combination of PrivateLink topology, NLB connection limiting to 50 concurrent TCP streams per target, and the endpoint acceptance requirement means an external attacker cannot establish the hundreds of simultaneous WebSocket connections needed to reliably trigger the race window.

config.deployment: EC2 in private subnet, no IGW, no NAT
